titulo: Almost 60% of primary energy used for electricity is lost to conversion and transmission
cuerpo: In 2025, the United States consumed 34 quadrillion British thermal units (quads) of primary energy to deliver 14 quads of electricity sales to end users, with nearly 60% lost. About 95% of the losses came from converting primary energy into electricity, mostly due to lost heat from burning coal and natural gas. The remaining 5% was lost in the course of delivering electricity across grid infrastructure to homes and businesses.
